value.rationale: A natural and exact complete palindrome-language invariant is classified across all finite cyclic modular-difference lifts from any base whose alphabet excludes nonzero opposites and whose zero-run bound is finite. In strictly ergodic Fibonacci examples, arbitrarily large delays exhibit a sharp finite cutoff and nonmonotone parity-sensitive tail; this is not supplied by the exact prior first-difference classification or the general strict-ergodicity criterion. The newly quantified return of nonconstant palindromes for every higher delay is structurally distinct from the first-difference collapse.
